verdict.rationale: TeamViewer documents a Web API, but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. Probes of the standard OpenAPI/Swagger paths and llms.txt all returned 404. Human-readable API docs do not count as a machine-readable spec, so this is adjacent support only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
